title: Target accuracy / %
description: Accuracy the budgets protect, 50–100. OK budget = OKs still allowed if every other remaining note is a GREAT; a miss costs two OKs.

title: Show pp
description: Current and full-combo pp during play and on results; pp at the target and for SS in song select.

title: Show unstable rate
description: Unstable rate of the attempt; the results screen keeps the last value.
